name: Miracle Automation Engineering Co.Ltd
summary: Miracle Automation Engineering Co.Ltd provides intelligent equipment solutions and services in China and internationally. It engages in the design, manufacture, and installation of intelligent automation systems; design and construction of opto-mechatronics and environmental protection engineering; intelligent equipment and robots; wind turbine generators and components; and lithium battery recycling activities. The company offers intelligent equipment, and robots, system integration control software, industrial control software, environmental protection equipment, wind power components, and lithium battery materials. In addition, it provides welding, painting, and general assembly equipment…
